title: economy

examples.zh: 小企业在当地经济中发挥重要作用。

scene: Big economy heading, IPA, meaning and definition left; rich main picture of an imaginary coastal town at right and below. title: afford
display_text:
IELTS 词汇手记 | 07
单词精讲 | 社会经济
afford

£180

example_zh: 我买得起一辆二手自行车。
